findings.claim: commands.md's fix column said "not JSON" while the check fails for any non-object
a non-UTF-8 hooks.json crashed doctor and install with UnicodeDecodeError

verdict.text: Both findings sent back are fixed and the fixes break nothing they touch.
The gates are green on this tree.

Gates: `loopctl gate stamp` from the worktree with a fresh scratch HOME printed `stamp green: d952252e2b4bbb4b0bd643de1baac9a53fa161b201fddc6afb852ca15bd9b07c`; lint, format, tests, integration, r1, r2 and r3 passed.
The scratch HOME had no git identity, so git printed an identity error before the gate lines; the stamp itself reported green.
f1: read the antigravity.apm-hooks row in docs/reference/commands.md.
Both the check column and the fix column now say "not a JSON object", which matches the doctor detail and the PluginError message.
f2: _apm_hooks_data catches UnicodeDecodeError with JSONDecodeError and raises PluginError for anything that is not a dict.
Doctor turns that into the repair-by-hand fail.
drop_apm_okf_stop catches PluginError and returns False, so install leaves the file alone instead of crashing.
The parametrized test_apm_hooks_unparsable_names_the_file_and_the_repair runs on invalid JSON, `[]` and `\xff\xfe` bytes and asserts the detail, the exact fix and exit code 1.
Without the UnicodeDecodeError catch, the bytes case would raise and fail.
f1: resolved in docs/reference/commands.md, which now says "not a JSON object".
f2: resolved in src/kmctl/antigravity.py (_apm_hooks_data), with the test in tests/test_doctor.py covering the non-UTF-8 case.
